dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Ugh... how many times do I have to tell you, it's not "boss lady."

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I'm the boss here at Wangshu Inn.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Hahaha, well I'd hardly be able to operate an inn in this location without connections with the Qixing.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: What I mean is I obviously need their approval.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: All that other nonsense is just rumors, though.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Speaking of which, have you got any interesting news to share?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: *sigh* ...This cat invited itself here... But it's cute, so I let it stay.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Its name is Wei. That was quite simply the first name we thought of.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: You might find Wei causes a bit of mischief — you know what cats are like. But please refrain from stooping to the same level yourself.
